borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
site_name: Former Fulham Boys School11 Mund StreetLondonW14 9LY
description: Redevelopment of the site to provide four residential buildings of between one and twelve storeys in height (Use Class C3) and two single storey ancillary buildings, together with substation, car and cycle parking, waste and recyclables storage, hard and soft landscaping, play space and other associated works. FOR THE PURPOSES OF CONSULTATION ONLY the proposal includes the provision of 107 residential units, with a size mix of 39No. 1 beds; 47No. 2 beds; 19No. 3 beds; 2No. 4 beds and a tenure mix of 22No. London Shared Ownership (20%); 53No. Market for Sale (50%) and 32No. Social Rent (30%)
